# We Don't Just Store Your Things — We Also Pack and Move Them Across 7 Cities | StowNest


[Packaging and Planning](https://stownest.com/blog/category/packaging-and-planning) ** Aug 29, 2026


** 18


[Add to Reading List](https://stownest.com/blog/login)


## StowNest isn't only a storage company. We also offer full packers and movers services across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, and Kolkata.


StowNest's storage services include packing and moving services. Along with self storage, we provide full service packers and movers in 7 cities: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, and Kolkata.


With StowNest, you can book each step of the process separately. Packing, loading, moving and delivery are independent services, and you are also able to choose between booking only the moving part and storage, or both together. It all depends on the requirements of the move you are planning.


## **Our Storage Services Have Earned Us an Industry Reputation. There’s More to Offer.**


If you ask a customer about our services, they’ll say we’re a storage company. We do have an excellent storage service. However, we do more than just store things. We take care of the entire moving process for our customers in and around seven cities. We even provide “ **[packing and moving service](https://stownest.com/packers-movers)** ” also. Where our team comes to your doorstep and packs your things and moves them to your new house or stores them in our storage facility till you request to return .


##


## **What "Packers and Movers" Actually Means Here**


What many of our customers consider a “packers and movers” service or a similar term is a service that physically transports a customer’s belongings at every stage of the moving process. At StowNest, we separate this as a separate service from storage. This means you can relocate without the need for self-storage.


## **When You Just Want Packing and Moving**


**[Packing and moving services](https://stownest.com/blog/ultimate-guide-to-hiring-packers-and-movers-in-bangalore-2026)** are best used if your new home will be ready for you to move in right away. In that case, a packing and moving service is ideal as it includes professional packing, transportation, and dropping your things off at your new home, all without requiring any type of storage.


## **When You May Want Both Services**


Sometimes there are gaps in the moving process. Maybe your current lease ends before you move into your new place. During those gaps, you can store your belongings in StowNest’s self storage. They are two separate services, so you would arrange for both moving and storage during your call with their customer support based on your particular situation.


## **How StowNest handles the packing and moving process step-by-step:**


The first step is giving us a call for a consultation. We then help you explain what you are moving and from what point to what new point. After this is explained we then go ahead and efficiently and effectively pack all of your belongings with the appropriate packing materials for Fragile, Furniture and the rest of your belongings and then load the whole shipment on our moving truck.


While staying on top of your shipment we even go the extra mile to assemble your furniture that needs to be disassembled for transportation at your new location.


## **Where You Can Find This Service**


StowNest packers and movers service is currently serving seven cities - Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, and Kolkata. If you are moving within a city or between any of the two cities, StowNest is able to facilitate your move.


## **What You Get With the Moving Service**


There are multiple elements of our moving service that include professional packing materials for various material types, careful loading and transport of your belongings, and disassembly and reassembly of your furniture. If you utilize any element of the StowNest storage service, that also includes protections that include ₹2.5 lakh worth of insurance, barcode tracking, and 24/7 surveillance of your stored belongings.


## **Two Services, One Provider For Both Needs**


You will not have to decide between choosing **[StowNest](https://stownest.com/self-storage)** for moving or for storage. They actually offer both as separate options. StowNest has both services, so whichever you need.or if you need both, it's still one service provider to you.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


**1. Does StowNest only provide storage or do they have packers and movers too?**


Yes,we have both services, full service packers and movers or self storage. Depending on the need, you can purchase them together or separately.


**2. Do we need to use your storage option if we use your packers and movers?**


No, if your move has no gaps, the packing and moving service is sufficient.


**3. What happens if my move in and move out dates do not match?**


You can arrange for **[self storage](https://stownest.com/self-storage)** during that period if you speak to support about booking the moving service.


**4. Are my items insured while they are being moved?**


Yes, the insurance covers items stored, up to ₹2.5 lakhs. For the transport, you need to speak to support for coverage.
